name: Shoulder CAR
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, brace your entire trunk tightly, and keep your working arm straight beside your hip.
Sweep your straight arm slowly upward in front of you until it reaches overhead without letting your ribs flare.
Rotate your shoulder smoothly inward as your arm reaches backward behind you in the widest possible pain-free arc back to your hip.
Reverse the entire path slowly back over your head to the start, then switch arms after completing one side.
tips: Keep your chest facing straight ahead without twisting your torso to gain extra range.
Move slowly under steady tension and reduce the circle slightly around any pinching spot.
